blurb: Wildflower Golf Course, located outside Detroit Lakes, is one of the best-kept secrets in all of Minnesota golf. Open prairie lands and oak-lined fairways make Wildflower an aesthetically pleasing and enjoyable course to play. Designed by Joel Goldstrand, a highly regarded golf course architect in the Midwest, the course’s distinctive “Prairie Links” design is unique in Minnesota.
